title: The One Who Watches Moon Addon
description: The One Who Watches Moon Addon replaces the sun and full moon with cracked, unsettling versions that make the sky feel eerie and unnatural. It's designed to perfectly complement The One Who Watches, enhancing the mod's horror atmosphere.
body: The One Who Watches Moon Addon is a simple visual addon that changes the appearance of the sun and full moon, replacing them with cracked and damaged versions that stand out in the sky. These altered textures create a strange, ominous feeling throughout your world and make nighttime look especially unsettling. Whether you're exploring, building, or surviving, the broken celestial bodies serve as a constant reminder that something is not quite right. This addon is intended to be used with The One Who Watches, helping to reinforce the mod's atmosphere and making horror-focused gameplay feel even more immersive without adding new mechanics or affecting performance.
